summary: Freebuff is an ad-supported coding agent available as a CLI, desktop app, web app builder, cloud IDE, and chat. Its current Free pricing lists 30 hours refilled daily, measured in MiMo Slow-equivalent hours: an hour on MiMo Slow uses one hour, while other models consume a multiplier. The Free plan estimates 30 hours of MiMo Slow, 15 hours of MiMo Fast, up to 10 hours of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash or 1 hour of Claude Haiku 5.5 per day when used on one model, with no card required. The allowance resets at local midnight and unused daily allowance does not roll over. These are full-access estimates: account and regional allowances vary, fair-use limits apply, and model prices and allowances may change. Sign in to confirm your account's allowance. The official README instead calls DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash unmetered at full access, conflicting with metered pricing; unlimited access is not verified. The embedded X announcement is historical evidence, not an account-specific guarantee. Uncertainty rechecked 2026-10-14: the metered/unmetered conflict persists, authenticated account/region/model allowances were not tested, and current CLI copy does not establish account-free onboarding. Confirm these before relying on the advertised allowance or signup-free access. The current README separately states that the limited-access allowance is 5 hours a day, or 4 on a VPN/proxy, metered at the selected model's multiplier and spent before earned wallet hours. This does not resolve the full-access metered/unmetered discrepancy; confirm the in-product allowance for your account.
claim_steps: Review the Free plan at https://freebuff.com/plans: 30 MiMo Slow-equivalent hours refilled daily, with other models consuming multipliers. Displayed hours assume full access; sign in to confirm your account's allowance.
Install the CLI (Node.js 18+): npm install -g freebuff
Run freebuff and describe what you want. Confirm the applicable account allowance before use; the Free plan states no card required, but account-free CLI onboarding has not been reverified.
Or use another Freebuff product: Desktop (freebuff.com/desktop), Web (freebuff.com/web), Cloud (freebuff.com/cloud), or Chat (freebuff.com/chat).
Use the daily allowance on one model or a mix; it resets at local midnight and does not roll over. Regional and fair-use limits may reduce access; the README/pricing conflict needs confirmation.
